claims.text: Metastatic cSCC: cetuximab (EGFR antibody) is moderately effective with surgery or radiation; PD-1 inhibitors (cemiplimab, pembrolizumab) are reserved for inoperable, advanced or metastatic disease
claims.quote: Cetuximab (an EGFR-blocking monoclonal antibody) has been moderately effective when co-administered with surgery or radiation (2). Programmed death receptor 1 (PD-1) inhibitors (eg, cemiplimab, pembrolizumab) are reserved for patients with inoperable, advanced, or metastatic disease (3, 4).
